producer_report.summary: Added one paragraph to the change verifier prompt. It tells verifiers to cite the recorded fmt, clippy and test results under "Checks Athena ran on this tree" and not rerun the full suite. A failed or missing record is not a pass, and then only that check is run. New behavior is exercised with `cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`. Added a CHANGELOG [Unreleased] "Added" entry citing the 2026-10-18 verifier timeouts (full suite about 11 minutes). The change verifier set is now 1265 tokens (was 1147), within the 1300 budget.

mistakes: My first full `cargo test --locked` output was too large to read inline, and the persisted copy was outside my working directory, so I reran it with --quiet.
learnings: Role token estimates are printed by the budgets test with --nocapture; the change verifier set was 1265 after the edit.
Grep and Read hooks refuse paths outside the working directory, including persisted tool output, so use `cargo test --quiet` to keep output short.
